description: Evaluation dataset (generation 2) for AskWRI Cite mode evaluation - cross-lingual corpus (en/zh/es/pt). Test cases are built by manually reviewing one sampled KP at a time and drafting a high-level English query whose expected answer is that document. expected_external_ids/expected_document_ids are parallel arrays (same index = same document, as external_id string vs UUID document_id).
